LLM Leaderboard - Comparison of AI models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, SpaceXAI & others

Comparison and ranking the performance of over 250 AI models (LLMs) across key metrics including intelligence, price, performance and speed (time per task in minutes & latency as time to first answer token), context window & others.

For more details including relating to our methodology, see our FAQs.

LLM API Providers LeaderboardTry it out

Intelligence

Updated

Gemini 4 Carbon (high) and Claude Opus 5.5 (max) are the highest intelligence models, followed by Gemini 4 Carbon (medium) and Claude Opus 5.5 (xhigh).

Time per Task

GPT-6 Luna (low) and GPT-6.1 Terra (low) have the lowest time per task, followed by Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite and GPT-6.1 Sol (low).

Time to First Answer Token

Tiny Aya Global and Phi-4 Multimodal have the lowest time to first answer token, followed by Celeris-1 and NVIDIA Nemotron Nano 9B V2.

Cost per Task

K2 Horizon 375B A23B and Command A+ have the lowest cost per task, followed by North Mini Code and GPT-6 Luna (low).

Context Window

Llama 4 Scout and GPT-6 Sol (Daybreak Blue, max) support the largest context windows, followed by Muse Wonder (max) and Muse Wonder (high).

Gemini 4 Carbon (High) currently ranks #1 on the Artificial Analysis LLM Leaderboard with an Intelligence Index score of 60, out of 97 models ranked.

The top models by Intelligence Index are: 1. Gemini 4 Carbon (High) (60), 2. Claude Opus 5.5 (Max, Default Fallback) (59), 3. Gemini 4 Carbon (Medium) (58), 4. Claude Opus 5.5 (Xhigh, Default Fallback) (57), 5. GPT-6 Astra (Max) (57).

GPT-6 Luna (Low) is the fastest, with the lowest time per task at 0.6 minutes per Intelligence Index task, followed by GPT-6.1 Terra (Low) (1.0 min) and Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite (1.7 min). Lower is better.

K2 Horizon 375B A23B has the lowest cost per Intelligence Index task at $0.00, followed by Command A+ ($0.00) and North Mini Code ($0.00).

Kimi K3.1 Pro is the highest-ranked open weights model with an Intelligence Index score of 46. There are 39 open weights models out of 97 total on the leaderboard.

The top open weights models by Intelligence Index are: 1. Kimi K3.1 Pro (46), 2. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 (Max) (33), 3. GLM-5.3 (Max) (32).

Gemini 4 Carbon (High) leads among 92 reasoning models with an Intelligence Index score of 60. Reasoning models use extended thinking to solve complex problems before responding.
